3. A related quantity is *amount-of-substance ratio of B* (commonly called "mole ratio of solute B"), symbol *r*~B~. It is the ratio of the amount of substance of B to the amount of substance of the solvent substance: *r*~B~ = *n*~B~/*n*~S~. For a single solute C in a solvent substance (a one-solute solution), *r*~C~ = *x*~C~/(1 − *x*~C~). This follows from the relations *n* = *n*~C~ + *n*~S~, *x*~C~ = *n*~C~ solvent substance S can itself be a mixture.
